said: We selected the four most widely distributed species (i.e., species occurring in ≥10 plots) in our study landscape to measure morphological attributes, which belonged to four different subfamilies following an evolutionary gradient from the closest to the baseline to the most evolutionary recent species (Dinoponera quadriceps (Ponerinae), Dorymyrmex goeldii (Dolichoderinae), Pheidole radoszkowskii (Myrmicinae), and Ectatomma muticum (Ectatomminae)) (Moreau & Bell, 2013).
We then analyzed Weber's length, eye length ratio, antenna length ratio, mandible length ratio, clypeus length ratio, leg length ratio, inter-ocular distance ratio, and pilosity.
